faces.name: Planet Killer
faces.oracleText:
Flying, indestructible
This creature attacks each combat if able.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it for each land that player controls.

faces.name: Planewide Celebration
faces.oracleText:
Choose four. You may choose the same mode more than once.
• Create a 2/2 Citizen creature token that's all colors.
• Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Proliferate.
• You gain 4 life.

faces.name: Planewide Disaster
faces.oracleText: When you encounter Planewide Disaster, destroy all creatures. (Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

faces.name: Plan for All Outcomes
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, the owner of up to one other target nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
Whenever you cast your first noncreature spell each turn, empower Jace 1. (Put a loyalty counter on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")

faces.name: Plant a Sapling
faces.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle this spell into its owner's library transformed. (For playtesting purposes, put it into its sleeve upside down.)

faces.name: Fully-Grown Treefolk
faces.oracleText:
(You can't cast this face unless it's been transformed by the front face.)
Fully-Grown Treefolk's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.

faces.name: Plant Elemental
faces.oracleText: When this creature enters, sacrifice it unless you sacrifice a Forest.

faces.name: Plan the Heist
faces.oracleText:
Surveil 3 if you have no cards in hand. Then draw three cards. (To surveil 3, look at the top three cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
Plot {3}{U} (You may pay {3}{U} and exile this card from your hand. Cast it as a sorcery on a later turn without paying its mana cost. Plot only as a sorcery.)
